news.body: Max Estates Limited appointed Ms. Jillian Leigh Moo-Young as an Alternate Director for Mr. Anthony Ramsey Malloy, Non-Executive Director of the Company, effective February 6, 2026. Ms. Jillian Leigh Moo-Young had vacated her office as Alternate Director in view of Mr. Anthony Ramsey Malloy having visited India to attend the Board meeting held on February 6, 2026.
